global_briefing: Tankers struck in the Strait of Hormuz and a drone alarm at an Iraqi gas field make Gulf shipping the top global item, since diesel, freight, insurance and sulphur costs reach North American mines first and Chilean and Congolese leaching through acid. Houthi moves toward Aden add Red Sea risk on the same routes. Trump's Asia trip, with Quad talks and a China visit, decides whether Chinese export licences for rare earths, antimony and tungsten ease or tighten. A US move to block Chinese remote access to AI chips and an Asian tech sell-off feed the copper AI sentiment channel. Russian strikes on Kyiv and Ukrainian drone strikes on the Crimea bridge keep European energy and sanctions in play, with less direct effect on Chile and Indonesia.
